description: Map of Slack functions the workflow engine can use. The AI/converger reads the AVAILABLE subset (implemented AND the client's token grants requiredScopes) so it only proposes actions that genuinely work. To add a capability: add an entry here, implement its handler in index.js, and flip `implemented` to true. Actions not listed are not proposable.

actions.label: Post a message to a channel
actions.description: Post a message to a public or private channel the bot can access.

config.hint: Channel ID (C…) or #name
Message text; omit to use the prior step output
Override the bot display name (requires chat:write.customize)
Override the bot icon emoji e.g. :robot_face: (requires chat:write.customize)

actions.label: Send a direct message to a user
actions.description: Open a DM with a user (by Slack user ID or email) and send them a message.

config.hint: Slack user ID (U…) or email address
Message text; omit to use the prior step output

actions.label: Reply in a thread
actions.description: Post a threaded reply under an existing message.

config.hint: Channel ID (C…) or #name
ts of the parent message to reply under
Reply text; omit to use the prior step output

actions.label: Add an emoji reaction to a message
actions.description: React to a message with an emoji.

config.hint: Channel ID (C…) or #name
ts of the message to react to
Emoji name without colons, e.g. white_check_mark

actions.label: Upload a file or snippet to a channel
actions.description: Upload text content or a file to one or more channels.

config.hint: Channel ID (C…) or #name
File text content or prior step output
File title shown in Slack
Filename with extension, e.g. report.txt

actions.label: Create a Slack channel
actions.description: Create a new public or private channel.

config.hint: Channel name (lowercase, no spaces)
true to create a private channel

actions.label: Invite a user to a channel
actions.description: Invite one or more users to a channel.

config.hint: Channel ID (C…) or #name
Comma-separated Slack user IDs to invite

actions.label: Set a channel topic
actions.description: Update the topic of a channel.

config.hint: Channel ID (C…) or #name
New topic text

actions.label: Pin a message in a channel
actions.description: Pin an existing message to a channel.

config.hint: Channel ID (C…) or #name
ts of the message to pin

actions.label: Set a reminder for a user
actions.description: Create a reminder for a user or the bot.

config.hint: Reminder text
When to send — unix timestamp or natural language e.g. 'in 30 minutes'
Slack user ID to remind (omit for the bot itself)

actions.label: Look up a user by email
actions.description: Resolve a Slack user ID from an email address.

config.hint: Email address to look up

actions.label: Search messages in Slack
actions.description: Search across messages and return matching results.

config.hint: Search query, supports Slack modifiers e.g. in:#channel from:@user
Max results to return (default 10)

actions.label: Read recent messages from a channel
actions.description: Fetch the most recent messages from a channel (useful for summarization or digest workflows).

config.hint: Channel ID (C…) or #name
Number of messages to fetch (default 20, max 100)
Fetch messages after this unix timestamp

actions.label: Send a group direct message
actions.description: Open a multi-person DM (MPIM) and send a message.

config.hint: Comma-separated Slack user IDs (2–8 people)
Message text; omit to use the prior step output
